ambiguities.text: The phrase 'maximum once per epoch (32 blocks)' for BlockRangeUpdate is ambiguous about enforcement mechanism.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a SHOULD-level recommendation rather than a MUST-level protocol requirement. Peers may rate-limit but not disconnect for violations.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail what happens when a peer claims a block range they don't actually serve.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard peer scoring applies: peers that fail to serve claimed blocks get penalized and eventually disconnected.

ambiguities.text: The term 'history expiry' is used without specifying minimum retention requirements.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume post-merge blocks must be retained, but pre-merge history can be fully discarded after May 1, 2025.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes sufficient nodes will continue serving historical data for clients that need it.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: New nodes may be unable to sync historical state, fragmenting the network.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes peers honestly report their available block ranges.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious peers could claim false ranges to attract connections then fail to serve, causing sync delays.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes bloom filter recomputation from logs is computationally efficient.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients with heavy log query workloads could experience performance degradation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes network has migrated away from total difficulty reliance post-merge.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Removing TD from handshake could break compatibility with pre-merge clients still on network.
